test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following Indian cricketers won the ICC Men's T20I Cricketer of the Year award for 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Surya Kumar Yadav.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Surya Kumar Yadav:-**

 
 
• He is a right-handed batsman who plays for Mumbai Indians in the Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
• He made his T20I debut for India in March 2021 against England.
 
• **In the year 2021, Surya Kumar Yadav had an impressive performance in T20I cricket, scoring 512 runs in 17 matches at an average of 38.23 and a strike rate of 145.02.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ishan Kishan:-**

 
 
• He is also a Mumbai Indians player who made his T20I debut for India in the same match as Surya Kumar Yadav.
 
• He had a good start to his T20I career, scoring a half-century on debut.
 
 
 
• **Shubman Gill:-**
 
 
• He is a young Indian opener who made his T20I debut in 2019. He has played 11 T20I matches for India so far, scoring 218 runs at an average of 21.80.
 
 
 
• **Bhuvneshwar Kumar:-**
 
 
• He is an Indian fast bowler who has been a regular member of the Indian cricket team for several years. He has played 50 T20I matches for India, taking 45 wickets at an average of 25.71.
